proof_text:
unfold allVowels allVowels_postcond
  have h_main : allVowels (s) h_precond = List.all (['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u'] : List Char) (fun v => (normalize_str s).contains v) := by
    unfold allVowels
    <;> simp_all [List.all_cons, List.all_nil]
    <;> rfl

  have h_final : allVowels_postcond s (allVowels s h_precond) h_precond := by
    simp_all [allVowels_postcond]
    <;> aesop

  exact h_final
